title: AI UGC Video Ads for Remodeling
description:
We’re a remodeling company based in Texas looking for a freelancer to create three realistic AI UGC video ads for Facebook and Instagram.

Our goal is to help homeowners imagine loving their home again—a welcoming kitchen, a relaxing bathroom, or a porch where the family gathers. We want warm, conversational storytelling that connects emotionally.

PROJECT SCOPE

Create three distinct videos, each 30–45 seconds:

Female spokesperson: A relatable woman speaking directly to the camera in a natural home setting.

Couple conversation: Two people discussing how they’d like their home to feel and function.

Project showcase: An AI spokesperson combined with photos and video clips of our actual remodeling work.

We’re open to your creative recommendations for different faces, settings, and approaches. 

WHAT WE’LL PROVIDE
• Company logo and brand colors.
• Photos and video clips of our actual projects.
• Service area details and call to action.

• Our actual project footage used to showcase completed work.

USAGE RIGHTS

The price must include unlimited, perpetual commercial usage rights with no expiration or renewal fees, covering paid ads, social media, our website, and future edits.

Please confirm that the AI platforms, avatars, voices, music, and other assets you use allow these rights for the delivered videos. Disclose any licensing restrictions before starting.

TO APPLY

• Two or three examples of realistic AI UGC ads you’ve created.

• Turnaround time and revision policy.

Please identify which portfolio examples use AI characters. We’re looking for someone who can handle both realistic AI production and engaging ad editing, with potential for ongoing work.

description:

I'm looking for an experienced UGC video editor to create **5 engaging Facebook and Instagram video ads** for an AI receptionist service targeting chiropractors.

**All footage has already been recorded.** I have filmed:

- **5 separate video hooks** (different opening lines).
- **1 main video body** (the same content for every ad).

- Edit the main video body once.
- Edit and polish all 5 recorded hooks.
- Attach each hook to the edited main body to create 5 variations.
- Add engaging, dynamic captions with highlighted keywords.
- Include relevant B-roll (chiropractors treating patients, phones ringing, appointment booking, etc.).

- Add appropriate background music and sound effects.

- Vertical 9:16 format (1080 × 1920).
- MP4 files ready for Facebook and Instagram advertising.
- Editable project files.
- Up to 2 rounds of revisions.

Natural, conversational UGC with fast-paced editing, large dynamic captions, strategic B-roll, and clean transitions.

The videos should feel authentic, not overly polished or like traditional commercials.

### What I'll Provide

- 5 prerecorded hook clips.
- 1 prerecorded main video body.
- The ad script.
- Creative direction and brand details.

### Requirements

- Experience editing UGC ads for Facebook and Instagram.
- Strong understanding of hooks, viewer retention, and direct-response advertising.
- Ability to add professional captions, B-roll, and motion graphics.
- Examples of similar ads you've edited.

### How to Apply

Plan before you cut. Every video starts with a creative direction — how it will open, where it turns, how it will feel. You decide that, not the timeline.

Design the sound. Not just placing a music track. Sound effects, texture, risers, impacts, ambience. Where the sound carries the video, and where it gets out of the way.

Analyse the music properly. We give you the track. You work out where the beat should build, where to hold tension, where to release it, where the momentum turns, and how the script's biggest line lands on top of it. This is one of the biggest differences between a good ad and a great one.
